scope: Frozen random42 Validation420 only. Read-only audit of the two existing prediction files; no training, no checkpoint selection, no Test labels, no Test predictions, no Test statistics, and no historical per-molecule Test analysis were opened.

checks.name: all_train_canonical_smiles_parse
checks.detail: RDKit parse of canonical Train3360 SMILES

checks.name: canonical_and_split_train_fingerprints_identical
checks.detail: Morgan(2,2048) bit sets are invariant to the split SMILES atom order

fingerprint_resolution.definition: max_train_sim == 1.0 groups: (a) valid molecule is also an exact canonical-SMILES duplicate of some Train3360 molecule, or (b) the Morgan(2,2048) bit set is identical to a structurally different Train3360 molecule (hashed-bit coincidence).

scaffold.definition: Bemis-Murcko scaffold canonical SMILES; empty scaffold falls back to the molecule's canonical SMILES

definitions.quartile_rule: sample 25/50/75 percentiles; inner boundaries are right-closed; values equal to a boundary go to the lower quartile

parameters.train_smiles: RDKit canonical SMILES (isomericSmiles=True) from the frozen Train3360 split SMILES
parameters.nearest_tie_break: first occurrence in frozen Train3360 order

neighbor_label_std.definition: population standard deviation (ddof=0) over all >=0.80 neighbors; exactly one neighbor gives 0.0

label_diff_to_nearest_neighbor.definition_signed: y_i - y_nearest; threshold set is the >=0.80 neighbor set

resolution_caveats.note: Tanimoto 1.0 on hashed Morgan bits is fingerprint equivalence, not molecular identity; it must not be read as a single-group edit.
